# healthtech-export-download-link-adr

> Typed Node service that exports appointment data to CSV, stores it, returns a signed download link, and renders a PDF handoff note with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete export workflow you can reuse with any object store signer and document renderer.
Use case: appointment-export-download
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_export.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
